verdict.rationale: Medusa is architected headless/API-first, with published OpenAPI specs for both the Store and Admin REST APIs (the same APIs that power its own admin dashboard), plus an official JS SDK — strongly implying the admin UI itself is just a client of the public API. However, there's no explicit documentation or independent confirmation asserting full UI/API parity, and the OpenAPI endpoint probes on the docs site itself 404'd. Missing for 10: explicit statement/guide confirming every admin-UI action has an API equivalent, and independent verification of complete parity.
